tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search active Jobiba vacancies by role or skill keywords, location, work mode, employment type, experience level and salary range (a salary range needs a currency and pay period). Returns job cards with title, company, location, published pay, skills, a description excerpt and URLs, with paging.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Retrieve one active Jobiba vacancy by jobId or slug: sanitized full description, published salary, skills, location and canonical URL. Inactive or expired postings are not returned.

tools.name: post_job
tools.description: Create an employer-owned job through Jobiba validation and plan limits.

tools.name: salary_analysis
tools.description: Basic salary range from matching active Jobiba jobs. salary_research returns a fuller view (percentiles, trend, experience curve, skill premiums, cities). Not financial advice.

tools.name: salary_research
tools.description: Salary research for a role from published Jobiba salaries: market percentiles (p10-p90) with sample size and confidence, 3-year trend, pay by experience level, skills associated with higher pay, best-paying cities, live jobs that publish pay, and plain-language observations. Returns an explicit no-d

tools.name: salary_calculator
tools.description: India pay calculators. mode 'ctc_to_in_hand' (needs annualCtc in INR) estimates monthly take-home with PF, gratuity and tax. mode 'hike' (needs currentSalary plus newSalary or hikePercent) shows the raise, real raise after inflation.

tools.name: company_insights
tools.description: Company research from Jobiba data: profile, verified status, open jobs, anonymous moderated employee reviews (ratings, would-recommend), interview difficulty and published pay by role.

tools.name: get_membership_plans
tools.description: Public plan and pricing information. Jobiba has no paid candidate plan (candidate tools are free); employer plans (Free, Starter, Growth, Enterprise) list prices, limits and features. No payment is taken by this tool.

tools.name: get_my_plan
tools.description: Employer's current plan, billing cycle, wallet, active-job usage vs limit, and what the next plan unlocks.

tools.name: start_plan_upgrade
tools.description: Prices an employer plan upgrade (monthly or yearly) and returns the secure jobiba.com billing link. It does not charge anything or collect payment details; payment is completed on jobiba.com. Enterprise is handled by contacting Jobiba.

tools.name: employer_dashboard
tools.description: Hiring snapshot: plan, wallet, active jobs vs limit, applications by stage, last-30-day impressions/clicks/apply clicks, top jobs and which premium features are on.

tools.name: list_my_jobs
tools.description: The employer's jobs with open/closed state, applicant counts, impressions and clicks.

tools.name: update_job_status
tools.description: Closes a job (removes it from search), reopens it within the plan's active-job limit, or extends its expiry by a number of days.

tools.name: list_applicants
tools.description: Applicants for one of the employer's jobs, or with no jobId the newest applicants across all of them (each row names its job): name, stage, fit score, applied date, plus stage counts and each applicant's newest interview (status and time) when one is set. With an email (one you already hold, for exa

tools.name: update_applicant_status
tools.description: Moves an application to APPLIED, SCREENING, INTERVIEW, OFFERED, HIRED or REJECTED. For most stages the candidate receives the standard Jobiba status email, as in the ATS dashboard. An application the candidate withdrew cannot be moved. An optional note is added to the team's internal notes on the ap

tools.name: job_health
tools.description: For one of the employer's jobs: the facts that hold it back and what to do, most useful first. Pay against the pay listed in ads for the same job title (the job page's own pay check, with the number of ads behind it), how many live job alerts on Jobiba match the job (a count only; never who; null be

tools.name: add_lead
tools.description: Stores a person who answered the employer's OWN form or advertisement (a lead ad, a landing page, an event list) beside one of the employer's jobs, before they apply. Find-or-create by job + email: a repeat updates the same lead and fills only what the new call states. Jobiba does not email or call

tools.name: list_leads
tools.description: The employer's leads (people it added from its own forms and ads), each with its job and whether that person has applied to it (same job, same email) with the application's stage. applied=true lists those who applied, newest application first; applied=false those who have not. Contact details are th

tools.name: find_candidates
tools.description: AI talent search over opted-in candidate profiles for a job (jobId) or a description/skills. Plan-gated (candidate matching); if the plan lacks it the result says which upgrade is needed.

tools.name: review_job_post
tools.description: Scores a job post (an existing jobId or a draft title and description) on length, structure, salary transparency, skills, inclusive language and clarity, and compares stated pay with published market salaries.

tools.name: screen_applicants
tools.description: Rank a job's active applicants by evidence-based fit (skills, experience, recency, logistics) with reasons, gaps and a shortlist/review/hold recommendation. Read-only: nobody is moved or emailed.

tools.name: candidate_profile
tools.description: Recruiter-safe candidate profile (summary, skills, experience, education; no phone/email) for an applicant or a candidate surfaced by find_candidates and visible to recruiters.

tools.name: shortlist_candidate
tools.description: Shortlist (bookmark) or skip a candidate from talent search; this also trains your future match ranking.

tools.name: list_shortlist
tools.description: Shortlisted and contacted candidates with scores, optionally for one job. Plan-gated.

tools.name: compare_candidates
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2-5 candidates for a job (score breakdown, matched/missing skills, notice period) with a recommendation.

tools.name: message_candidate
tools.description: Sends recruiter outreach to a talent-search candidate. Without confirm=true it returns a preview and sends nothing; with confirm=true it sends an email through Jobiba (limits: 20 per day, 2 per candidate per 30 days). The candidate's contact details are never exposed.

tools.name: edit_job
tools.description: Updates fields of one of the employer's jobs (title, description, location, type, mode, level, salary, skills, apply URL) and re-indexes it for search.

tools.name: draft_job_post
tools.description: Generates a job post draft from a short brief, using only facts in the brief (a structured template if AI is unavailable), and scores it.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "hiring" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_job, company_insights, list_applicants, add_lead, list_leads, screen_applicants, message_candidate, edit_job · Private data: get_my_plan, employer_dashboard, list_applicants, list_leads, message_candidate · Public sink: post_job, salary_research, list_applicants, update_applicant_status, add_lead, list_leads, review_job_post, candidate_profile, message_candidate, draft_job_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_job, company_insights, list_applicants, add_lead, list_leads, screen_applicants, message_candidate, edit_job · Private data: get_my_plan, employer_dashboard, list_applicants, list_leads, message_candidate · Public sink: post_job, salary_research, list_applicants, update_applicant_status, add_lead, list_leads, review_job_post, candidate_profile, message_candidate, draft_job_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_applicants" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
